teams.detail: Eliminated by Cavaliers in East Semis (L G7, 94-125 on May 18). Best playoff run since 2008. Offseason begins.
At Royals tonight, 7:40 PM CT. Logan Gilbert starts. Season record 24-27.
Schedule out: 6 primetime games, opens vs. Patriots Week 1. JSN signed 4yr/$168.6M extension. OTAs underway.
Spring game done: Purple 27, Gold 10. Kodi Greene emerging at LT. Season kickoff ~100 days away.
4 transfers added: Venters (Gonzaga), Watts (Texas Tech), Beasley & Friedrichsen (SF). 3 roster spots remain for 2026-27.

headlines.headline: MICHIGAN RELOADS FOR 2026-27; FLORIDA, DUKE LEAD WAY-TOO-EARLY RANKINGS
headlines.detail: Defending champion Michigan added Thiam, Estrella, and Reed via transfer. Florida No. 1 after Haugh and Condon return. Tournament expands to 76 teams next year.

headlines.headline: SPURS-THUNDER GAME 3 TONIGHT, SERIES TIED 1-1; KNICKS UP 2-0 ON CAVALIERS
headlines.detail: West Finals Game 3 tips at 8:30 PM ET in San Antonio. East: Knicks lead 2-0, Game 3 Saturday in Cleveland.

headlines.headline: AARON RODGERS CONFIRMS 2026 IS HIS FINAL SEASON AS OTAs BEGIN LEAGUE-WIDE
headlines.detail: Rodgers, 42, will retire after one year with Steelers under McCarthy. Stafford extended at $55M/yr with Rams. Giants lose Robertson-Harris to torn Achilles in OTAs.

headlines.headline: 100 DAYS TO KICKOFF: BIG TEN LEADS WITH 8 NEW QBS, CFP EXPANSION TALKS INTENSIFY
headlines.detail: Season 100 days away. Big Ten: 8 teams with new starting QBs. 24-team CFP format push heating up among commissioners.
